image.name: signal
image.description: [Signal](https://signal.org/) is a messaging app with privacy at its core. It is free and easy to use, with strong end-to-end encryption that keeps your communication completely private.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Use Wayland ozone platform fixes scaling and acceleration.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: Signal desktop gui HTTP must be proxied.

image.title: Signal
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

>[!WARNING]
>This container does not encrypt Signal's config.json using a secret manager like gnome-keyring or kwallet, the file is stored in plaintext.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  signal:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/signal:latest
    container_name: signal
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=signal \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/signal:latest
